test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill blank 4.
solution:
The correct answer is 'call for'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's take a look at the phrase: will also (4) ______ collaborative research in infectious disease management and development of vaccines and the resultant social issues 
 
• If we look at the option, it is clear that it will get filled with phrasal verb.
 
• Let's take a look at the meaning of the given options:
 
 
• call off: cancel an event or agreement.
 
• call in: ask someone to come and help
 
• call out: summon someone to deal with an emergency or provide a service.
 
• call for: to need or deserve a particular action, remark, or quality:
 
 
 
• Thus, from above, we can say that the correct answer is option 4.
